title: OpenAI
full_text: OpenAI is an AI research organization. It develops models like GPT and tools such as ChatGPT, and works on AI safety and deployment.
summary_text: OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company known for developing GPT models and ChatGPT.

title: Python (programming language)
full_text: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language emphasizing readability with significant indentation and a large standard library.
summary_text: Python is a high-level programming language created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.

title: Alan Turing
full_text: Alan Turing was an English mathematician and computer scientist. He helped break Enigma and proposed the Turing machine and the Turing test.
summary_text: Alan Turing (1912–1954) was a British mathematician and pioneer of computer science and cryptanalysis.

title: C (programming language)
full_text: C is a general-purpose programming language created at Bell Labs by Dennis Ritchie. It has influenced many later languages and systems software.
summary_text: C is a general-purpose programming language developed in the early 1970s by Dennis Ritchie at Bell Labs.

title: Linux
full_text: Linux is a family of open-source Unix-like operating systems based on the Linux kernel, first released by Linus Torvalds in 1991.
summary_text: Linux is an open-source Unix-like operating system family based on the Linux kernel.

title: Machine learning
full_text: Machine learning is a field of AI focused on algorithms that learn from data. It includes supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
summary_text: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence focused on building systems that learn from data.

title: Large language model
full_text: A large language model is a language model with many parameters trained on large text corpora, often using transformer architectures.
summary_text: Large language models are statistical language models with many parameters trained on large datasets.

title: Transformer (machine learning model)
full_text: The transformer is a deep learning architecture based on self-attention, introduced in the 2017 paper "Attention Is All You Need".
summary_text: Transformers are neural network architectures using attention mechanisms and are widely used in NLP.

title: Attention Is All You Need
full_text: "Attention Is All You Need" is a 2017 paper introducing the transformer architecture for sequence transduction, replacing recurrence with self-attention.
summary_text: Attention Is All You Need is a 2017 paper that introduced the transformer model architecture.

title: BERT (language model)
full_text: BERT is a transformer-based machine learning technique for NLP developed by Google. It uses bidirectional training of transformers for language understanding.
summary_text: BERT is a transformer-based language model introduced by Google in 2018 for natural language understanding.

title: ChatGPT
full_text: ChatGPT is a chatbot developed by OpenAI and launched in 2022. It is based on large language models and supports conversational interactions and tool use.
summary_text: ChatGPT is an AI chatbot by OpenAI, released in November 2022, built on large language models.

title: GPT-4
full_text: GPT-4 is a large multimodal model created by OpenAI, announced in 2023. It is used in products such as ChatGPT and via APIs.
summary_text: GPT-4 is a large language model by OpenAI announced in 2023, used in ChatGPT and offered via API access.

title: Artificial intelligence
full_text: Artificial intelligence is intelligence demonstrated by machines. It includes approaches such as symbolic AI, machine learning, and deep learning.
summary_text: Artificial intelligence is the field of creating machines capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence.

title: Neural network
full_text: Artificial neural networks are computing systems inspired by biological neural networks. They are used for tasks like classification, regression, and generation.
summary_text: A neural network is a computing system of interconnected nodes used in machine learning and pattern recognition.

title: Deep learning
full_text: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning using neural networks with many layers. It is used in vision, speech, and language applications.
summary_text: Deep learning is a class of machine learning methods based on multilayer neural networks.

title: Backpropagation
full_text: Backpropagation is an algorithm for training neural networks by computing gradients of a loss function with respect to weights via the chain rule.
summary_text: Backpropagation is a method used to train artificial neural networks by propagating error gradients backward.

title: GraphQL
full_text: GraphQL is a query language for APIs and a runtime for fulfilling those queries, developed internally at Facebook and released in 2015.
summary_text: GraphQL is a query language for APIs and a server runtime for executing queries with existing data.

title: Representational state transfer
full_text: Representational state transfer (REST) is a software architectural style defining constraints for web services, emphasizing stateless communication and resources.
summary_text: REST is an architectural style for designing networked applications, commonly used for web APIs.

title: HTTP
full_text: HTTP is an application-layer protocol for distributed, collaborative, hypermedia information systems. It is the foundation of data communication on the Web.
summary_text: HTTP is the foundational protocol used for transferring web pages and API payloads on the World Wide Web.

title: Rust (programming language)
full_text: Rust is a multi-paradigm programming language focused on performance and safety, especially safe concurrency. It is developed by the Rust project and community.
summary_text: Rust is a programming language designed for performance, memory safety, and concurrency.

title: Kubernetes
full_text: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration system for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications, originally designed by Google.
summary_text: Kubernetes is an open-source system for automating deployment and management of containerized applications.

title: Docker (software)
full_text: Docker is a set of platform as a service products that use OS-level virtualization to deliver software in packages called containers.
summary_text: Docker is software that uses containerization to package applications and their dependencies.

title: Cloud computing
full_text: Cloud computing is the on-demand availability of computer system resources, especially data storage and computing power, without direct active management by the user.
summary_text: Cloud computing provides on-demand computing resources delivered over the internet, often with pay-as-you-go pricing.

title: Amazon Web Services
full_text: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon providing on-demand cloud computing platforms and APIs, including compute, storage, and databases.
summary_text: Amazon Web Services is a cloud computing platform offered by Amazon, providing infrastructure and application services.

title: Microsoft Azure
full_text: Microsoft Azure is a cloud computing platform operated by Microsoft. It provides compute, analytics, storage, and networking services.
summary_text: Microsoft Azure is Microsoft’s cloud computing platform offering infrastructure and platform services.

title: Google Cloud Platform
full_text: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a suite of cloud computing services that runs on the same infrastructure that Google uses internally for products like Search and YouTube.
summary_text: Google Cloud Platform is a set of cloud services from Google offering compute, storage, and data analytics products.

title: CRISPR
full_text: CRISPR is a family of DNA sequences found in prokaryotes and a technology for gene editing based on CRISPR-associated proteins such as Cas9.
summary_text: CRISPR is a gene-editing technology derived from a bacterial immune system, widely used in biology and medicine.

title: James Webb Space Telescope
full_text: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) is a space telescope designed for infrared astronomy. It was launched in 2021 and is a project of NASA, ESA, and CSA.
summary_text: The James Webb Space Telescope is an infrared space observatory launched in 2021 to study the early universe and exoplanets.

title: Quantum computing
full_text: Quantum computing uses quantum-mechanical phenomena such as superposition and entanglement to perform computation. Quantum algorithms can offer speedups for some problems.
summary_text: Quantum computing is a type of computation that leverages quantum mechanics to process information.

title: Sourdough
full_text: Sourdough is bread made by the fermentation of dough using naturally occurring lactobacilli and yeast. It has a mildly sour taste and improved keeping qualities.
summary_text: Sourdough is bread made with a fermented starter, using wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria for leavening and flavor.

title: COVID-19
full_text: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) is an infectious disease caused by SARS-CoV-2. It led to a global pandemic beginning in 2019.
summary_text: COVID-19 is an infectious disease caused by SARS-CoV-2 that resulted in a global pandemic.

title: TikTok
full_text: TikTok is a short-form video hosting service owned by ByteDance. It allows users to create and share videos with music, effects, and filters.
summary_text: TikTok is a short-form video platform owned by ByteDance, popular for algorithmic recommendations and creator content.

title: Apple Inc.
full_text: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company that designs and sells consumer electronics, computer software, and online services, including the iPhone and Mac.
summary_text: Apple Inc. is a technology company known for the iPhone, Mac, iPad, and services like iCloud.

title: The Lord of the Rings
full_text: The Lord of the Rings is an epic high-fantasy novel by J. R. R. Tolkien. It is set in Middle-earth and follows the quest to destroy the One Ring.
summary_text: The Lord of the Rings is a high-fantasy novel by J. R. R. Tolkien, published in three volumes in 1954–1955.
